written: 2026-10-20, before building or running the setup scanner
idea: trade only Elliott decision points, as practitioners do, and test whether the parent / grandparent count (multi-generation context) adds skill
events: a new pivot is CONFIRMED (causal ATR zigzag, k=2.5) on tf in {5-min, 1-hour, daily}; the engine counts the last 30 known pivots + the running leg

setups.S12_early3: best scenario = IMPULSE (or LEADING_DIAG) with waves 1-2 complete, the just-confirmed pivot is the END OF WAVE 2, price has not yet passed the end of wave 1. Entry = close of the confirmation bar; stop = end of wave 2; target = end of 2 + 1.0 x wave 1 (secondary 1.618 x)
setups.S45_early5: best scenario = IMPULSE with 1-4 complete, the just-confirmed pivot is the END OF WAVE 4, price below the end of wave 3. Stop = end of 4; target = end of 4 + 0.618 x wave 1

variants.B_parent: parent count (next coarser timeframe: 5m->1h, 1h->daily, daily->weekly) is in a MOTIVE leg in the SAME direction
variants.C_parent_grand: B and the grandparent (two timeframes up) also in a motive leg in the same direction
variants.D_inner5: A and wave 1 subdivides best as a 5-wave motive (bottom-up evidence > 0)

horizon: until target or stop, max 3 x the duration of wave 1 (min 20, max 400 bars)
benchmark: drift-matched null: same symbol, same direction, same target % and stop %, same horizon, 40 random dates
pass: skill (hit - null hit) >= +0.05 AND R-expectancy above the null's with day-clustered t >= 2, for up and down setups each >= 0 skill, in both original-15 and new-30 symbol groups
amendment_before_results: 2026-10-20: compute limits -> 5-min run restricted to the original 15 symbols, 2025-07-01 -> 2026-09 (~1,700 events each); 1-hour and daily unchanged (45 symbols). Scanner counts the last 20 pivots with at most 1 irregular end and without triple-threes (speed).
